meta.note: Buyer-facing question set. Titles are editorial hypotheses. No search-volume, popularity or superiority claim is made anywhere, and none was obtained.
meta.rule_for_every_guide: A capability is stated only if it appears in the seller's own listing title. Everything else is framed as a question the reader should ask, not as an answer supplied by this site.

clusters.name: Choose the shape
clusters.intent: The reader has not decided between a drawer-style basket and a countertop oven.
clusters.decision_it_resolves: Which physical form fits the food they actually cook and the counter they actually have.

clusters.name: Size it honestly
clusters.intent: The reader knows the shape but not how the quart number maps to a meal.
clusters.decision_it_resolves: Whether a stated capacity is enough for the number of people they cook for.

clusters.name: Live with it
clusters.intent: The reader is close to buying and is worried about cleaning and counter footprint.
clusters.decision_it_resolves: Whether they will still use the appliance in month three.

clusters.name: Buy the function, not the badge
clusters.intent: The reader is being sold 'multi-function' and wants a way to test that claim.
clusters.decision_it_resolves: Which of the advertised functions they will genuinely use, and which are packaging.
